messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: customer marlinsec — latency SLO breach detected. p95=1.72s (SLO=0.5s), p99=4.82s (SLO=2.0s). Region: eu-west-3. Affected pool: marlinsec-dedicated-eu-west-3. Error spike: 503/timeouts. Paging on-call: @maya_oncall

maya_oncall: On call, joining. Any immediate mitigation suggestions?

marlinsec_sre_liaison: Customer reports elevated tail latencies across sync gen endpoints. We see sustained request queueing on the dedicated pool; a small subset of tenants are dominating CPU/KV cache.

ops_lead_ana: TL;DR — p95/p99 exceeded for ~12 minutes, traffic concentrated on shard nodes 3-5. Likely hot-tenant. Impact: 1 enterprise customer (marlinsec) major degradation, affects realtime auth flows.

sam_platform: I'm going to increase pool capacity and trigger tenant isolation. Planning commands: `rcli pool scale --pool marlinsec-dedicated-eu-west-3 --delta +8` and then `rcli tenant isolate --tenant marlinsec-heavy-queue --pool marlinsec-dedicated-eu-west-3`

nic_devops: Copying commands to runbook. I'll execute scale now.

support_jordi: Marlinsec SRE Slack pinged and on call. They asked for a temporary fallback to the lower-latency model variant while we mitigate.

eng_runtime_lee: We can flip routing for the customer to the smaller quantized variant to reduce per-token CPU. Route change: `rcli route set --customer marlinsec --pool marlinsec-dedicated-eu-west-3 --model marlinsec-small-quant --policy immediate`

marlinsec_sre_liaison: Please make that change; their SRE approves fallback for 30 minutes. They'll accept slightly lower quality for availability.

nic_devops: Scale command started: `kubectl -n inference scale statefulset marlinsec-dedicated --replicas=+8` (monitoring cluster autoscaler). ETA ~90s for additional workers to join.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: pool scale job submitted (job id pool-scale-5060012345). Progress: 3/8 nodes up.

maya_oncall: Starting tenant isolation step now. Evicting suspected heavy tenant queue to cold lane. Command: ```
# evict heavy tenant
rcli tenant evict \
  --tenant marlinsec-heavy-queue \
  --pool marlinsec-dedicated-eu-west-3 \
  --target-pool marlinsec-cold-eu-west-3 \
  --reason "cpu-queueing-emergency"
```

ops_lead_ana: Note: eviction will drop in-flight sessions for that tenant — marlinsec confirmed non-critical background worker. Proceed.

incident-bot: :hourglass_flowing_sand: Eviction started (evict-job-7701). Tracking: 25% migrated.

sam_platform: Routing change applied to fallback model variant. `route set` returned OK. Confirming with internal smoke: sending 50 test requests -> median latency down from 1.6s to 0.48s.

marlinsec_sre_liaison: Their metrics page shows successful reduction in tail, errors dropping. They're seeing 200->higher success on auth calls.

eng_runtime_lee: KV cache warmup might be contributing to residual p99. Suggest prewarmed prefix cache for critical keys: `cache prewarm --pool marlinsec-dedicated-eu-west-3 --keys staging-auth-* --concurrency 10`

nic_devops: Eviction finished. in-flight impacted: 12 jobs retried, all requeued to cold lane. Pool nodes stabilized, CPU per node now 42%.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Metrics update: p95=0.49s, p99=1.18s. SLO still technically breached for p99 vs 2.0s threshold? Wait — p99 now under threshold. Good: p95/p99 within SLO.

maya_oncall: Marking incident as mitigated. Handoff: I'll own postmortem and runbook updates. Next steps: confirm root cause (hot tenant + suboptimal routing quantization fallback missing), document eviction playbook, add automated detection for tenant queue growth.

ops_lead_ana: Customer comms: support_jordi to coordinate an update for Marlinsec. Keep them in the loop for rollback timing (we can revert model routing after 30m).

support_jordi: Noted — drafting message. Will send preliminary status and ETA for full recovery revert window (T+30m).

maya_oncall: Postmortem owner: @maya_oncall. Priority: P2. Tagging for infra/serving/console teams. Closing war room in 10m unless regressions. :thumbsup:
